description: Distinguishes missing process identity in WinForms from UI or compiler failure.
prompt: Rowan Claims needs to appear in the Windows Share sheet, but Package.Current throws 0x80073D54 when I hit F5. Can we make it work locally and for customers without replacing our WinForms MSI?

paraphrases.novice: The forms in Rowan Claims work, but our sharing code fails with 0x80073D54 because Windows doesn't know which app the program belongs to. How do I fix that for debugging and for staff who install our MSI?
paraphrases.terse: Rowan F5: Package.Current 0x80073D54. Need Windows Share sheet support here and with the existing MSI.

routingSnapshotReason: A failing debug process and retained MSI are represented by a project extract and exception capture.
